name: about-fit
description: Open-source AI marketing studio for apparel brands.

scripts.db:migrate: bash scripts/link-env.sh && pnpm --filter @about-fit/api exec prisma migrate dev

scripts.db:studio: bash scripts/link-env.sh && pnpm --filter @about-fit/api exec prisma studio
